correction_lesson: A team's per-match stat lives in EITHER the home_* column (when it played at home) OR the away_* column (when away) of the wide matches table. Summing only one side undercounts. Union both: SUM of home_<metric> WHERE home_team_id=team plus away_<metric> WHERE away_team_id=team.
description: Team-season aggregation pattern: cards/discipline must be summed across BOTH home and away fixtures from the wide matches table (a common mistake is counting only one side). Beneficiary repeats the pattern for a different team/metric.

turns.query: How many yellow cards did Arsenal receive in total during the 2023-2024 Premier League season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(cards) AS total_yellows FROM (SELECT m.home_yellow_cards AS cards FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.home_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND t.team_name = 'Arsenal' UNION ALL SELECT m.away_yellow_cards AS cards FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.away_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND t.team_name = 'Arsenal') x;

turns.query: How many total fouls did Liverpool commit across the 2024-2025 Premier League season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(f) AS total_fouls FROM (SELECT m.home_fouls AS f FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.home_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2024-2025' AND t.team_name = 'Liverpool' UNION ALL SELECT m.away_fouls AS f FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.away_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2024-2025' AND t.team_name = 'Liverpool') x;
